questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you not to drive in your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means it is not safe to enter the indicated road or driveway from your current direction. Turn around and find a different route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers to be careful in work zones. This sign tells you that construction ahead will change your route. Be ready to follow a redirected path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that there are multiple lanes available for left turns. Drivers in the far left lane must turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white rectangles with black markings. You must obey all regulatory signs. Where this sign is posted, passing other vehicles is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and prepare you for upcoming hazards. This sign alerts you to watch for bicycles crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop, whether there’s a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children crossing the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Always yield to pedestrians in or entering a crosswalk. Stay alert for pedestrians when driving through intersections or turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
Lane reduction; the left lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: This sign indicates that the right lane will end ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is posted at the end of one-way streets. It warns you not to enter the road from this direction. If you see this sign, stop and turn around.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign warns you that a stop sign is coming. Prepare to come to a complete stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no less than 35 mph around the curve ahead.
Curve ahead, speeds of 35 mph or slower are recommended.
Stay in the right-hand lane if not driving over 35 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: Curve ahead, speeds of 35 mph or slower are recommended.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a curve ahead in the direction of the arrow. It recommends driving at 35 mph or slower through the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that a bridge with narrow lanes is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you to watch for cattle that may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means you cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells you to wait for the left turn signal before turning left. Only turn left when the signal indicates it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a road intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Merging traffic is approaching from the left.
Right lane ends ahead, merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Right lane ends ahead, merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the right lane is ending. You must move into the left lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means you must yield. Slow down as you approach the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, bicyclists, and pedestrians pass safely before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching you.
Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, not always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a complete stop. Let vehicles and pedestrians in or near the intersection pass safely, then go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers they may turn right or go straight at an intersection from the marked lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic is merging into your lane from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means parking is not allowed in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This triangular sign warns you to slow down and be ready to stop at the intersection. Yield to other drivers and pedestrians. You may go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign shows your road is crossing a divided highway. A divided highway has two separate one-way roads separated by a median or guard rail.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. They alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that a divided highway is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and warn of upcoming hazards. This sign tells you to drive carefully when the road is wet and slippery.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
That due to upcoming roadwork, there is a detour to the right.
Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: This sign means the road ahead makes a sharp turn in this direction. Slow down before the curve as you would at a sharp intersection turn.
